India's Solar Power Boom Faces Regional Imbalance

India's solar power industry is experiencing a boom, but it is facing regional imbalances and manufacturing gluts. While some states are leading the way in solar power generation, others are struggling to keep up with demand. The government has been promoting renewable energy as part of its efforts to reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
